posts.cooked:

Hello, to the best of my knowledge, I don’t see why option 4 (which has been given as the correct answer) is true. If file1 is assumed to be not empty, then shouldn’t the contents of file1 be added to file2, to file3 as well as to the terminal?

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: If you redirect the output to file2, nothing is sent to the pipe, thus tee creates empty file and prints nothing to terminal

posts.name: Yashvi Dhaddha
posts.cooked: Ohh okay. This makes sense. Thank you so much.
